test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following question is based on the given seven, 3-digit numbers.

(Left) 347, 486, 627, 113, 721, 418, 779 (Right)

(For example, 456 : 6 = digit in unit's place, 5 = digit in ten's place, 4 = digit in hundred's place)

NOTE - All operations to be done from left to right.

If 2 is added to the digit in hundred's place of each number given above, in how many numbers will be the modified digit in hundred's place be exactly divisible by the digit appearing in the ten's place?
solution: Given: (left) 347, 486, 627, 113, 721, 418, 779 (right) If 2 is added to the digit in the hundred's place of each number given above, the modified numbers will be: • 347 → 547 • 486 → 686 • 627 → 827 • 113 → 313 • 721 → 921 • 418 → 618 • 779 → 979
